posts.content:
The 2027 Medicare Advantage and Part D Final Rule is turning up the heat on Star Ratings. ⭐

CMS is removing 11 measures, many tied to administrative processes, and increasing the relative influence of clinical performance, including greater weight on HEDIS. Add in a new behavioral health measure and changes to how bonus factors are applied, and the message is clear: Star Ratings can’t be treated as a seasonal push anymore.

👉 That urgency is showing up in today’s landscape. Per CMS’s 2026 Star Ratings Fact Sheet, the enrollment-weighted average MA-PD Star Rating declined from 4.14 in 2023 to 3.98 in 2026, and only about 40% of MA-PD contracts earned four Stars or higher.

Our new article, written in collaboration with Jessica Muratore, Founder of Muratore Advisory Services, LLC, reflects her insights on the future of MA Star Ratings–what has changed, why it matters for quality leaders, and how plans can shift from year-end tactics to year-round operational discipline. 💡 

Read more: https://lnkd.in/gegf9TyF.
